title: Left and Right Sum Differences
summary: Given an integer array nums of size n, create an array answer of size n where each element answer[i] is the absolute difference between the sum of elements to the left of index i and the sum of elements to the right of index i in nums.
statement: Given an integer array nums of size n, create an array answer of size n where each element answer[i] is the absolute difference between the sum of elements to the left of index i and the sum of elements to the right of index i in nums.
constraints: For each index, left sum excludes nums[index] and contains all earlier values.
Right sum excludes nums[index] and contains all later values.
Return the absolute difference at every index.
hints: Initialize right as the total sum and left as zero.
Before recording an index, subtract its current value from right.
Append abs(left-right), then add the current value to left.
Those update positions maintain exactly the sums strictly before and strictly after each index.
editorial: Those update positions maintain exactly the sums strictly before and strictly after each index.

tests.explanation: The four left/right differences are fifteen, one, eleven, and twenty-two.
Both excluded-side sums are zero, so the only difference is zero.
